Title: Predictive maintenance preconfigured solution for Microsoft Azure IoT Suite

Body.Content: Microsoft Azure IoT Suite helps you capture and analyze untapped device data to improve results across your business. With preconfigured solutions, you can quickly and confidently get started with a solution tailored to meet your business needs, then scale your Internet of Things (IoT) projects across your company. The remote monitoring and the predictive maintenance preconfigured solutions are now available. For more information about how Azure IoT Suite can help you anticipate maintenance needs and avoid unscheduled downtime, please visit the Internet of Things site.
